title: If you need a good sermon today …
excerpt: You’ve probably never heard the grandson of a famous Pentecostal televangelist who speaks like this: Pay attention to Drew Sumrall – he represents what is happening among many thoughtful children and grandchildren of more conventional conservative Christians in America.
